auth.title: Philips Hue login
auth.description:
**Before you start:**
1. Requires a Hue account with a configured Secure camera.
2. In the Hue app go to *Settings → Security → Video surveillance* and turn **E2EE / encrypted live view OFF** – otherwise the stream stays encrypted.
3. Have the **Home ID** (16 digits) ready: sign in at the [Hue account portal]({portal}), open your home, the ID is in the address bar after `/homes/`.

**Login:**
Open this link and sign in:

{url}

Then paste the full redirect URL (`https://account.meethue.com/?code=...`) below.

home.title: Enter Home ID
home.description:
16-digit home ID of your account.

**How to find it:** [open the Hue account portal]({portal}) → sign in → click your home. The 16 digits are in the address bar after `/homes/`.

Example: `4618484926709760`

error.auth_failed: Login failed – check the URL and try again.
error.cannot_connect: Hue cloud unreachable or wrong Home ID.
error.no_cameras: No Hue Secure camera found in this home.
